notes: Modest single-storey cottage: warm cream stucco (#d0c5a9) under a red clay-tile GABLE roof (#b8594f) with a brown timber eave/fascia board (#ab9578) and generous overhang; ridge runs parallel to the street, gable ends left/right. Spec v2 said 'hipped' but the iso clearly shows a gable - kept gable. Two blue-framed windows on the street facade (slate-blue glass #556482, blue-grey frames #84909f), otherwise blank walls; the right gable-end wall is slightly greyer (#999586) with VERTICAL panel joints (band schema has no vertical style or facade key - noted). Twin solar collectors (#5a5d77 panels, #7a7c88 frames) on the front roof slope near the ridge - expressed via roof.props per the plan doc. Spec mentions a satellite dish but none is on this building in the refs (dishes sit on neighbours). FRONTAGE: no wall or gate - a knee-to-waist-high run of boxy low-poly HEDGES (#828d44 lit / #7f893e shade) lines the corner frontage, so wall is omitted (hedge factory pending); behind the hedge at the right edge a short blue picket fence with a YELLOW mailbox on it, and a timber power pole with sagging wires crosses the frame (props pending). The street here is a plaza-like PAVING-STONE surface (grey-tan pavers #bcac99 with tan accent bands #b19881 and darker joints #ad937b) that continues as the road band (#baa996) - no asphalt, no kerb-separated verge. Tall palm at frame left, round trees and cypresses on the skyline belong to neighbours. Sampled from 12x9 scene grid + 24x18 iso grid 2026-07-03.
